headline.sentence: You are leaving ₹22.3L on the table this week — ₹9.8L in free-rider promotions in Snacks & Biscuits, ₹6.2L in cost passthrough gaps, and ₹3.4L in premature markdowns.
headline.supporting_line: Optimization model has 11 actionable recommendations that could recover ₹8.4L this week.
headline.season_context: Pre-Eid build · 20 days to Eid al-Adha

action_queue.headline: 58% of promo buyers are free-riders — ₹5.7L in discount waste this week.
action_queue.recommended_action: Gate offer to new-to-brand and lapsed segments only. Estimated saving: ₹3.2L.

action_queue.headline: Cost up 8% since last review — shelf price not updated, margin now 12.0%.
action_queue.recommended_action: Raise shelf price by ₹30 to restore target margin.

action_queue.headline: Margin at 8.0% — 10.0pp below the Dairy & Frozen floor.
BOGO on Edible Oil: 57% free-rider ratio — loyal buyers stocking up, not switching.
action_queue.recommended_action: Switch to Bundle mechanic with a new SKU (Saffola + spice combo). Projected ₹2.8L leakage recovery.

action_queue.headline: Supplier cost increase not passed through — ₹1.2L weekly margin gap accumulating.
action_queue.recommended_action: Review pricing agreement with merchandising team before next cycle.

action_queue.headline: Inelastic demand (ε=-0.93) — price increase of ₹-24 has minimal volume impact.
action_queue.recommended_action: Approve recommended price change ahead of Eid demand build.

action_queue.headline: Tea Festive Bundle paused — ₹3.4L unspent budget at risk of lapsing.
action_queue.recommended_action: Redirect remaining budget to Loyalty Gold Cashback (best-performing campaign, 3.7× ROI).

action_queue.headline: 13.4 weeks of supply and sell-through at 45.61% — markdown trigger hit.
action_queue.recommended_action: Apply 30% markdown to clear 1443 units at risk.

action_queue.headline: Weekend Snack Bundle free-rider ratio at 62% — highest in current portfolio.
action_queue.recommended_action: Monitor through week-end before adjusting. Consider loyalty-gating in next campaign cycle.

action_queue.headline: Sell-through 12pp below category average — demand softness or placement issue.
action_queue.recommended_action: Check shelf placement and review if reorder point is too high for current pace.

action_queue.headline: 24 Mantra Sona Masoori 5kg margin trending toward floor — monitor over next 2 weeks.
action_queue.recommended_action: No action needed now. Alert auto-escalates to Review if margin drops another 2pp.

ai_suggestions.explanation: Free-rider ratio is only 31% — well below category average. Increasing cashback depth from 10% to 15% for loyalty-gated customers projects ₹2.1L incremental revenue with 86% confidence.
ROI at 0.72× is well below the 3.0× goal. 91% confidence that continuing burns budget with no incremental lift — the buyer cohort has price-anchored at the discounted level.
ROI at 3.2× is tracking above goal with no post-promo dip detected. Extending for 7 more days while Eid demand is building projects ₹1.4L additional lift at 78% confidence.
Redirect ₹4.2L of unspent Oil BOGO budget to the Loyalty Cashback campaign. Oil BOGO has 57% free-rider waste vs 31% for Cashback — same spend, ₹1.8L more incremental projected.
Loyal Core customers have 71% free-rider ratio on this campaign — they buy Atta regardless. Excluding this segment from the discount saves ₹1.2L with minimal volume impact.

inventory_aging.insight: 13W+ stock down 41% vs same week last year — markdown acceleration program is working
